Lévi, translated from the author's Portuguese; compare Waite's public-domain "Transcendental Magic". "LËVI" in the original corrected to LÉVI. The author's emphasis is not marked in the extracted text.
The original spells the title "Misterium Conjunctionis"; corrected to Jung's Latin title "Mysterium Coniunctionis" (also the title of the English edition).
